identity.name: MiniusLight-24B
identity.summary: MiniusLight-24B is a Slerp merge of two Mistral Small 24B models, TheDrummer/Cydonia-24B-v2 and PocketDoc/Dans-PersonalityEngine-V1.2.0-24b.

possible_risks.description: Copyrighted information or other intellectual property might be included as a part of the prompt that is sent to the model.
possible_risks.justification: The model is a merge of two named third-party Mistral Small 24B checkpoints, so users may prompt it with copyrighted or licensed material, and the card's cc-by-nc-4.0 license does not address input-side IP.

possible_risks.description: Confidential information might be included as a part of the prompt that is sent to the model.
possible_risks.justification: It is an open-weight text-in/text-out model with no stated privacy or data-handling safeguards, so users can include confidential information in prompts.

possible_risks.description: Hallucinations generate factually inaccurate or untruthful content relative to the model's training data or input. Hallucinations are also sometimes referred to lack of faithfulness or lack of groundedness. In some instances, synthetic data that is generated by large language models might include hallucinations that result in the data possibly being inaccurate, fabricated, or disconnected from reality. Hallucinations can compromise model performance, accuracy, and relevance.
possible_risks.justification: The card reports strength in roleplay, ERP, and story writing but no factual grounding or evaluation, so generated narrative content is plausibly factually inaccurate.
